overview_description.description: Emerge Career platform offers vocational training for people released from prison to get immediate jobs. Emerge Career provides training programs for government agencies looking to create high-paying jobs, reduce recidivism, and lift incarcerated people out of poverty. Emerge Career matches students with partner schools for accelerated hands-on training and eventually connects graduates with a network of employers.

product.name: Workforce Development Platform
product.description: A platform that manages the entire workforce development cycle from recruitment to job retention for low-income and justice-impacted individuals.

product.name: Digital Learning Hub
product.description: An online, secure learning interface accessible on any device, including offline, for vocational training and exam preparation.

product.name: Student Success Coaching
product.description: Individualized coaching providing mentorship, goal setting, and personalized support to students throughout their training and employment journey.

product.name: Hands-on Training Placement
product.description: Facilitation of student placement with partner educators for accelerated, practical vocational training programs.

identifier.value: Career Coaching and Job Placement Support

product.name: Career Coaching and Job Placement Support
product.description: Services that assist graduates with job search strategies, interview preparation, resume building, and connection to employers.

product.name: Workforce Development Analytics
product.description: A data analytics tool providing real-time insights and reports on student progress, program outcomes, and workforce development impact.
